Description of business and organization of Nextpower Inc. Nextpower Inc. and its subsidiaries (“Nextpower”, “we”, the “Company”) is a leading global provider of solar and energy technology solutions for utility-scale power plants. Founded in 2013 by our Chief Executive Officer, Dan Shugar, Nextpower pioneered and remains the global market leader in solar tracking systems. Nextpower now delivers an integrated suite of structural, electrical, and digital solutions across the full lifecycle of solar power plants, from design and construction through operations and maintenance. Nextpower’s integrated solutions are designed to streamline project execution, increase energy yield and long-term reliability, and enhance customer return on investment.
